subject: Following up from Inference Summit — next steps on inference roadmap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@retailai.com>, Kelly Thompson <kelly@retailai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Following up from Inference Summit — next steps on inference roadmap

Hi Samir / Kelly —

Great meeting you both at the Inference Summit last week — really enjoyed the conversation about RetailAI's latency and scale needs for real-time product recommendations. A quick recap from our side so we keep momentum: 

- Current ask: reduce 95th percentile latency for the recommender from ~220ms down to <120ms at 50 req/s while keeping per-token costs in check.
- Constraints: PCI scope for payment flows, customer PII never leaves our environment, preferred private VPC deployment but open to a managed Dedicated approach if it simplifies rollout.
- Success criteria: sub-120ms p95 on prod traffic profile, predictable unit costs, and a simple rollout path with A/B traffic split.

Next steps I propose:
1) 30-min technical demo of Redwood Dedicated vs. Private (we'll show latency profiles and a mutual action plan)
2) Share SOC 2 + data handling docs for your security team
3) Outline an estimated TCO and a short pilot plan (2-4 weeks)

I've attached a short one-pager and our pricing snapshot so you have something to share internally (Attachment: Redwood_one-pager.pdf, Redwood_pricing-deck.pdf). Would you be available for a 30-min call next week (I included a Calendly link below)? If next week is tight, happy to push to the week of Mar 9.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182
https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

(Attachment: Redwood_one-pager.pdf (pdf), Redwood_pricing-deck.pdf (pdf))

Hey Marissa —

Great to meet you as well — thanks for the recap. RetailAI is definitely interested, particularly around the private deployment option given our PCI considerations. A few quick notes from my side:

- We're collecting SOC 2 evidence now; can you send the SOC 2 report and a short note on data-at-rest encryption?
- Timing is a little tight for us; the product team is heads-down until early March. Could we tentatively book something the week of Mar 9?
- I've looped Kelly to coordinate procurement/security review.

If you can share the SOC 2 + encryption notes and a brief pilot proposal, I'll get those in front of our security and product leads.

Thanks — Samir
